standard.title: Properties of Quadrilaterals
standard.description: establish properties of quadrilaterals using congruent triangles and angle properties, and solve related problems explaining reasoning
standard.prior_knowledge: Students can classify quadrilaterals and state their properties (from AC9M7SP02). Students can identify congruent triangles (from AC9M8SP01).
standard.progression_endpoint: Students establish properties of quadrilaterals by reasoning with congruent triangles and angle facts, and solve multi-step problems with full geometric justification.

nodes.label: Establishing quadrilateral properties via congruent triangles
nodes.progression_checkpoint: Students use diagonal decomposition into triangles and congruence arguments to establish properties of specific quadrilaterals.
nodes.minimum_width: Show that the diagonals of a rectangle bisect each other using congruent triangles.
nodes.typical_width: Establish properties of parallelograms, rhombuses and rectangles using congruent triangles and angle facts; state each property with justification.
wider: Establish properties of a kite using congruent triangles — which diagonal is the axis of symmetry? Prove using the congruence argument.
Apply quadrilateral properties to construction designs: car jacks, scissor lifts, folding umbrellas — identify which property makes the design functional.

response_modes.reason: Geometric proof via congruent triangles requires an explicit scaffold: decompose the quadrilateral, identify the congruence condition, state matching elements, conclude the property. Students without this structure produce informal and incomplete arguments.

nodes.hinge_reason: Node 2 requires applying established quadrilateral properties to solve multi-step problems — students who have not established those properties with justification have no valid properties to draw on, reducing Node 2 to guessing or memorisation.
success_criteria: Uses a congruence argument to establish at least one quadrilateral property.
States each step with a geometric reason.
Does not assert properties without justification.

nodes.label: Solving problems using quadrilateral properties
nodes.progression_checkpoint: Students use established quadrilateral properties to find unknown angles and lengths, providing full geometric reasoning.
nodes.minimum_width: Find an unknown angle or side in a quadrilateral using at least one established property.
nodes.typical_width: Solve multi-step problems combining quadrilateral properties, parallel line angle facts, and triangle angle sums; give reasons for every step.
wider: Investigate which quadrilateral properties are preserved under each transformation type — connect to the congruence and similarity work from AC9M8SP01.
Design a problem requiring at least three geometric reasoning steps using quadrilateral properties — write the full solution with reasons.

response_modes.reason: Solving multi-step quadrilateral problems requires drawing on the full repertoire of angle properties, congruence conditions, and quadrilateral-specific facts simultaneously.

nodes.width_opportunity_reason: Designing multi-step geometric reasoning problems is a rich task for advancing students — constructing a problem requires deeper understanding of which properties chain together than solving a given problem.
success_criteria: Finds unknown angles or lengths using quadrilateral properties correctly.
States a geometric reason for each step.
Solves at least one multi-step problem without prompting for each step.
